name: Nebula
description: Nebula is a multi-tenant collaborative envisioning platform that enables organizations to run structured ideation workshops with real-time participation. Facilitators guide cohorts through a configurable sequence of modules—including brainstorming, AI-powered categorization, pairwise voting, stack ranking, marketplace allocation, 2x2 priority matrices, staircase prioritization, and surveys—culminating in AI-generated personalized results for each participant. The platform supports both authenticated users and anonymous guests, offers Microsoft Entra ID SSO with per-tenant configuration, and provides comprehensive admin controls for organizations, workspaces, and user management.

name: Constellation
description: Constellation is a comprehensive multi-tenant SaaS platform designed to manage the entire lifecycle of consulting projects—from estimation and resource allocation through time tracking, expense management, and automated invoice generation. Built for consulting businesses, it combines AI-powered narrative generation, Microsoft 365 integrations (Azure AD SSO, SharePoint, Planner, Outlook), and robust financial reporting to streamline operations, ensure accurate billing, and provide real-time visibility into project health and profitability.

name: M-Files Workspaces
description: M-Files Workspaces, redefining how organizations manage and understand their information in the age of AI. Built on M-Files’ unique context-first architecture, Workspaces is the business application and user experience layer that simplifies complexity and instantly brings together every related document, project, and stakeholder in a single view, delivering a smarter, faster way to work. Instead of simply storing documents, Workspaces takes a context-first approach — linking content to the people, projects, and processes that give it purpose. The result is a unified view of work that empowers employees, strengthens compliance, and improves performance.

name: Themis IA
description:
Your solution to stress-free information architecture development
Many organizations today live with information architecture chaos – unable to dedicate months of time, energy and resources towards the necessary improvements.
THEMIS IA can help – fast.
With the ability to easily and efficiently update and maintain your information architecture - THEMIS IA is a perfect solution for a centralized IA that manages the structure and experience of your SharePoint Online.

THEMIS IA will help you to design, build and publish the building blocks required for SharePoint Online, all in one central location. Our code-free information architecture solution streamlines your information architecture development process - reducing your deployment time by 50% or more. We do this by automating the complex and time-intensive task of building and maintaining a robust information architecture.

name: Themis ICE
description: THEMIS ICE is an intelligent migration product that assists organizations with discovering content; identifying redundant, obsolete, and transitory documents (ROT); auto-classifying documents using Microsoft Syntex; and enabling the intelligent migration of unstructured information into managed repositories such a SharePoint Online

name: Vega
description: Vega is an AI‑augmented Company Operating System that helps organizations align strategy with execution by connecting mission, values, OKRs, and priorities into a single, living system. It integrates with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID to power role‑based insights, focus rhythms, and board‑ready reporting grounded in real work. Vega turns strategy into daily clarity—using AI to surface what matters most, when it matters.

name: SharePoint
description: Microsoft SharePoint is Microsoft’s enterprise content and collaboration platform that helps organizations securely store, organize, share, and manage information through websites, document libraries, lists, and intranet experiences, all tightly integrated with Microsoft 365 apps like Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Copilot. It is used to power team collaboration spaces, company intranets, knowledge management, and workflow-driven business processes, enabling people to find information quickly, co‑author content in real time, and apply governance, security, and compliance controls at scale across the organization.

name: Zenith
description:
Zenith is Synozur’s centralized governance control plane for Microsoft 365, built for IT leaders, governance teams, and managed service providers operating complex, multi‑tenant environments. It unifies workspace visibility, automated policy evaluation, sensitivity and retention alignment, and Copilot readiness tracking into a single, secure system—eliminating reliance on scripts, manual audits, and fragmented tools. 

Zenith integrates with Microsoft Entra ID for tenant‑isolated identity, multi‑factor authentication, and granular role‑based access control, ensuring the right users have the right visibility at the right time. Governance decisions are written directly back into SharePoint so Microsoft Purview can enforce policies natively, creating a closed loop between governance intent and day‑to‑day operations. 

Hosted in SOC 2 Type II–certified data centers and designed for enterprise‑grade security and auditability, Zenith helps organizations govern at scale, reduce risk, and confidently prepare their Microsoft 365 environments for Copilot and future AI adoption.

name: AI Strategy and Design
description: We bring clarity and purpose to AI, aligning tools like Copilot with meaningful business outcomes. From ethical design to pilot programs, we help you chart a course that blends innovation with human impact.
